run_agent_inference: run the SAM3 agent inference loop to segment objects in an image given an initial text prompt
save_debug_messages: save conversation messages to a debug jsonl file when debug mode is enabled
count_images: count the total number of image content items in a list of conversation messages
cleanup_debug_files: remove debug jsonl file and debug folder after successful agent execution
prune_messages: prune conversation messages to keep only the first two messages and the latest tool call segment
